title.sl: If I had, if I'd known · Kaj bi bilo, če
title.de: If I had, if I'd known · Was wäre, wenn
title.it: If I had, if I'd known · Cosa succederebbe se
title.en: If I had, if I'd known · What if

description.sl: Kar ni tako: za if preteklik, would le v drugi polovici: If I had a boat, I'd row across, ne *If I would have a boat*. Nasvet: If I were you. Kar se ni zgodilo: If I'd known, I'd have come.
description.de: Was nicht so ist: nach if das past, would nur in der anderen Hälfte: If I had a boat, I'd row across, nicht *If I would have a boat*. Ein Rat: If I were you. Was nicht geschah: If I'd known, I'd have come.
description.it: Ciò che non è così: dopo if il past, would solo nell'altra metà: If I had a boat, I'd row across, non *If I would have a boat*. Un consiglio: If I were you. Ciò che non è successo: If I'd known, I'd have come.
description.en: What isn't so: the past after if, would only in the other half: If I had a boat, I'd row across. Advice: If I were you. What didn't happen: If I'd known, I'd have come.

review: en, sl, de, it: machine-written (Claude), not reviewed by a native speaker

story.sl: Old Wilf sits under the oak with Bess. "If I were young again," he says, "I'd climb Scafell Pike once more." · Old Wilf sedi z Bess pod hrastom. »Če bi bil spet mlad,« pravi, »bi še enkrat splezal na Scafell Pike.«
story.de: Old Wilf sits under the oak with Bess. "If I were young again," he says, "I'd climb Scafell Pike once more." · Old Wilf sitzt mit Bess unter der Eiche. »Wenn ich noch mal jung wäre«, sagt er, »würde ich noch einmal auf den Scafell Pike steigen.«
story.it: Old Wilf sits under the oak with Bess. "If I were young again," he says, "I'd climb Scafell Pike once more." · Old Wilf è seduto con Bess sotto la quercia. «Se fossi di nuovo giovane», dice, «salirei ancora una volta sullo Scafell Pike.»
story.en: Old Wilf sits under the oak with Bess. "If I were young again," he says, "I'd climb Scafell Pike once more."

exercises.prompt: If I ___ a boat, I'd row across the lake.

explain.sl:
**Za if preteklik, would le v drugi polovici. Slovenščina reče bi v obeh**
- **If I had a boat, I'd row across.** · Če bi {m:imel|f:imela} čoln, bi {m:veslal|f:veslala} čez.
explain.de:
**Nach if das past, would nur in der anderen Hälfte. Deutsch sagt hätte und würde**
- **If I had a boat, I'd row across.** · Wenn ich ein Boot hätte, würde ich hinüberrudern.
explain.it:
**Dopo if il past, would solo nell'altra metà**
- **If I had a boat, I'd row across.** · Se avessi una barca, andrei dall'altra parte a remi.
explain.en:
**The past after if, would only in the other half**
- **If I had a boat, I'd row across.**

explain.de:

- **If I were you, I'd wait.** · An deiner Stelle würde ich warten.
explain.it:
**Un consiglio: If I were you, I'd … (a voce anche If I was you)**
- **If I were you, I'd wait.** · Se fossi in te, aspetterei.
explain.en:

exercises.prompt: If I'd known you were coming, I ___ a cake.

explain.sl:
**Kar se ni zgodilo: if + had + deležnik, v drugi polovici would have + deležnik**
- **If I'd known, I'd have baked a cake.** · Če bi {m:vedel|f:vedela}, bi {m:spekel|f:spekla} torto.
explain.de:
**Was nicht geschah: if + had + Partizip, in der anderen Hälfte would have + Partizip**
- **If I'd known, I'd have baked a cake.** · Wenn ich es gewusst hätte, hätte ich einen Kuchen gebacken.
explain.it:
**Ciò che non è successo: if + had + participio, nell'altra metà would have + participio**
- **If I'd known, I'd have baked a cake.** · Se l'avessi saputo, avrei fatto una torta.
explain.en:
**What didn't happen: if + had + the participle, would have + the participle in the other half**
- **If I'd known, I'd have baked a cake.**

options: If I had time, I'd help.
If I would have time, I'd help.
If I'd known, I'd have come.
I'd row across if I had a boat.
If I would know the way, I'd tell you.
If it hadn't rained, we wouldn't have stayed.

explain.sl:
**would le v drugi polovici, ne za if**
- **If I knew the way, I'd tell you.** · Če bi {m:poznal|f:poznala} pot, bi ti {m:povedal|f:povedala}.
- **If I'd known, I'd have come.** · Če bi {m:vedel|f:vedela}, bi {m:prišel|f:prišla}.
explain.de:
**would nur in der anderen Hälfte, nicht nach if**
- **If I knew the way, I'd tell you.** · Wenn ich den Weg wüsste, würde ich ihn dir sagen.
- **If I'd known, I'd have come.** · Wenn ich es gewusst hätte, wäre ich gekommen.
explain.it:
**would solo nell'altra metà, non dopo if**
- **If I knew the way, I'd tell you.** · Se sapessi la strada, te la direi.
- **If I'd known, I'd have come.** · Se l'avessi saputo, sarei venut{m:o|f:a}.
explain.en:
**would only in the other half, not after if**
- **If I knew the way, I'd tell you.**
- **If I'd known, I'd have come.**

instruction.sl: Fill the gap · Dopolni: Če bi bila Bess mlajša, bi še vedno tekala na hrib.
instruction.de: Fill the gap · Ergänze: Wenn Bess jünger wäre, würde sie noch den Berg hinauflaufen.
instruction.it: Fill the gap · Completa: Se Bess fosse più giovane, correrebbe ancora su per il monte.
instruction.en: Fill the gap: If Bess were younger, she'd still run up the fell.

exercises.text: If Bess ___ (be) younger, she'd still run up the fell.
accept: were
was

hint.de: Bess ist alt: Es ist nicht so.
hint.it: Bess è vecchia: non è così.
hint.en: Bess is old: it isn't so.

explain.sl:
**Kar ni tako: za if preteklik. Pri be piše were, govori se tudi was**
- **If Bess were younger, …** · Če bi bila Bess mlajša, …
explain.de:
**Was nicht so ist: nach if das past. Bei be schreibt man were, gesprochen auch was**
- **If Bess were younger, …** · Wenn Bess jünger wäre, …
explain.it:
**Ciò che non è così: dopo if il past. Con be si scrive were, a voce anche was**
- **If Bess were younger, …** · Se Bess fosse più giovane, …
explain.en:
**What isn't so: the past after if. With be, writing wants were; people also say was**
- **If Bess were younger, …**

instruction.sl: Fill the gap · Dopolni: Kaj bi {m:naredil|f:naredila}, če bi {m:zadel|f:zadela} na srečelovu?
instruction.de: Fill the gap · Ergänze: Was würdest du tun, wenn du bei der Tombola gewinnen würdest?
instruction.it: Fill the gap · Completa: Che cosa faresti se vincessi alla lotteria?
instruction.en: Fill the gap: What would you do if you won the raffle?

exercises.text: What ___ you do if you won the raffle?
accept: would

hint.sl: Vprašaš po nečem, kar ni tako.
hint.de: Du fragst nach etwas, das nicht so ist.
hint.it: Chiedi di una cosa che non è così.
hint.en: You're asking about something that isn't so.

explain.sl:
**Vprašanje: would pred osebkom, za if preteklik**
- **What would you do if you won?** · Kaj bi {m:naredil|f:naredila}, če bi {m:zadel|f:zadela}?
explain.de:
**Die Frage: would vor dem Subjekt, nach if das past**
- **What would you do if you won?** · Was würdest du tun, wenn du gewinnen würdest?
explain.it:
**La domanda: would prima del soggetto, dopo if il past**
- **What would you do if you won?** · Che cosa faresti se vincessi?
explain.en:
**To ask: would before the subject, the past after if**
- **What would you do if you won?**

explain.sl:
**Kar se ni zgodilo: za if had + deležnik (leave, left, left)**
- **If we'd left earlier, …** · Če bi šli prej, …
explain.de:
**Was nicht geschah: nach if had + Partizip (leave, left, left)**
- **If we'd left earlier, …** · Wenn wir früher losgegangen wären, …
explain.it:
**Ciò che non è successo: dopo if had + participio (leave, left, left)**
- **If we'd left earlier, …** · Se fossimo partiti prima, …
explain.en:
**What didn't happen: had + the participle after if (leave, left, left)**
- **If we'd left earlier, …**

instruction.sl: Fill the gap · Dopolni: Če ne bi deževalo, ne bi ostali v gostilni.
instruction.de: Fill the gap · Ergänze: Wenn es nicht geregnet hätte, wären wir nicht im Gasthaus geblieben.
instruction.it: Fill the gap · Completa: Se non avesse piovuto, non saremmo rimasti alla locanda.
instruction.en: Fill the gap: If it hadn't rained, we wouldn't have stayed at the inn.

would not have stayed
wouldn't've stayed

hint.de: Es hat geregnet, und wir sind geblieben.

explain.sl:
**V drugi polovici: wouldn't have + deležnik**
- **We wouldn't have stayed.** · Ne bi ostali.
explain.de:
**In der anderen Hälfte: wouldn't have + Partizip**
- **We wouldn't have stayed.** · Wir wären nicht geblieben.
explain.it:
**Nell'altra metà: wouldn't have + participio**
- **We wouldn't have stayed.** · Non saremmo rimasti.
explain.en:
**In the other half: wouldn't have + the participle**
- **We wouldn't have stayed.**

prompt.de: Wenn ich es gewusst hätte, wäre ich gekommen.
prompt.en: If I'd known, I'd have come.

explain.sl:
**Dvakrat 'd: prvi je had (za if), drugi would (pred have)**
- **If I'd known, I'd have come.** · Če bi {m:vedel|f:vedela}, bi {m:prišel|f:prišla}.
explain.de:
**Zweimal 'd: das erste ist had (nach if), das zweite would (vor have)**
- **If I'd known, I'd have come.** · Wenn ich es gewusst hätte, wäre ich gekommen.
explain.it:
**Due volte 'd: il primo è had (dopo if), il secondo would (prima di have)**
- **If I'd known, I'd have come.** · Se l'avessi saputo, sarei venut{m:o|f:a}.
explain.en:
**'d twice: the first is had (after if), the second would (before have)**
- **If I'd known, I'd have come.**

explain.sl:
**Za if preteklik (had), v drugi polovici would + glagol**
- **If I had a boat, …** · Če bi {m:imel|f:imela} čoln, …

explain.de:
**Nach if das past (had), in der anderen Hälfte would + Verb**
- **If I had a boat, …** · Wenn ich ein Boot hätte, …
- **… I'd row across.** · … würde ich hinüberrudern.
explain.it:
**Dopo if il past (had), nell'altra metà would + verbo**
- **If I had a boat, …** · Se avessi una barca, …
- **… I'd row across.** · … andrei dall'altra parte a remi.
explain.en:
**The past after if (had), would + the verb in the other half**
- **If I had a boat, …**
- **… I'd row across.**
